contributions.claim: Saudi officials report three citizens killed and others wounded in a late-Thursday Riyadh airport attack claimed by Houthis.
contributions.attribution: Saudi officials; Houthi responsibility claim via Guardian

contributions.claim: A later Guardian report describes a Houthi missile attack at Riyadh airport with dozens reported wounded; Saudi authorities had not confirmed the strike.
contributions.attribution: Guardian, unspecified injury reports and witness
contributions.uncertainty: No explicit event date supplied; may be separate attack or another account of Thursday occurrence.

contributions.claim: Trump says he is evaluating US participation in Saudi strikes against Houthis.

relations.reason: Same airport and actor but absent date; casualty and confirmation differences do not alone prove either a correction or second attack.
Source directly places airport attack in the Yemen offensive context.

delta_expectations.reason: Airport violence and potential US involvement materially advance the ongoing matter; identity of two airport reports must remain qualified.

questions.claim: Whether the two airport reports describe one attack or separate attacks cannot be determined from supplied event timing.

ambiguity_notes: Repeated government-allied strait-recapture claim adds no demonstrated independent resolution of C04-control-question.
